concepts.name: The Parallel Branch
concepts.summary: LoRA runs in parallel with the frozen weight, not as a layer stacked after it. Both the base path and the adapter path receive the same input x and their outputs are added: y = W . x + B . A . x. The branch adds a small learned correction to what W already does rather than transforming W's output.

concepts.name: The Rank Bottleneck
concepts.summary: Shape trace along the LoRA branch: x is (d,), A . x is (r,), squeezed to the rank-r bottleneck, then B. (A . x) is (d,), expanded back. Passing through an r-wide waist makes the branch's d x d effect at most rank r, so the bottleneck structurally forces the update to be low-rank.
